prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1292; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain radiating into the trapezius region, low back pain with stiffness, and intermittent headaches. Examination revealed limited cervical range of motion, particularly in rotation and extension, paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, and mild muscle guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits, sensory changes, or reflex asymmetry noted. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Over the course of 17 visits, treatment consisted of a combination of manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, soft tissue mobilization, and modalities for pain control as needed. The patient demonstrated gradual improvement in range of motion and pain intensity, with a reduction in headache frequency and improved tolerance for sitting and lifting. Home exercise program adherence was good, and the patient was educated on posture, ergonomic modifications, and activity pacing.

At discharge, the patient reported residual mild stiffness with occasional flare-ups related to prolonged positioning. Continued self-directed exercise and activity modification are recommended, with follow-up as needed should symptoms recur or worsen.
